This was a collection of short stories and novellas set throughout the Cosmere, and in terms of lore it is an 11/10, especially Mistborn: Secret History. Helped to explain a ton of things and was really fun to read, I also really enjoyed Edgedancer since Lift is a nifty character. I have officially read everything currently written in the Cosmere and would appreciate more content please.
